description: Explore careers and further learning in either direction. From the person's learning: the occupations and program areas their statements (proposed ones too, with their affirmation shown), the phrases you name from their descriptions, or their words reach through the KSA Dictionary's link words, a page at a time. From a target they name or select: an occupation (SOC code), a certification (its id), a program (a CourseShelf program_id or a CIP code) or a Transitions destination (to_soc with its from_soc), by the identifier the service returned; no earlier interview answer is needed and a package is started when none is sent. Each answer gives the source, the O*NET elements the person's statements share with it, questions to explore from every O*NET branch (paged), learning areas or occupations it crosses to (paged), and keeps the possibility in the person's record with what prompted it. Exploration only: not a qualification, a score, a credit award or verified competence. A statement comes only from what the person then describes in their own words.

channel.description: How the person said it; text when omitted

from_descriptions.description: From the person's learning: phrases you name from their recorded descriptions

phrases.description: The words in their description that carry what they did

interest_words.description: The person's own words naming this as something they want to explore; kept as an interest linked to the target

learning_areas.description: From a target: { limit, offset } for the learning areas or occupations it crosses to

limit.description: From the person's learning: connections per page (default 20, at most 50)

offset.description: From the person's learning: the next_offset of a previous answer

package.description: The package the last GoldSeam Selfie answer returned (goldribbon_package_v1 with its selfie_interview part). Keep it for the person and send it back whole; GoldSeam keeps no copy.

prompted_by.description: What prompted this exploration: statement_ids, description_ids, interest_id or explored_id the package holds

questions.description: { limit, offset }: the page of questions to explore (default 20, at most 50)

statement_ids.description: From the person's learning: only these statements; every statement not set aside when omitted

target.description: From a target: what the person names or selects, by the identifier its service returned

code.description: A SOC code, a certification id, a CourseShelf program_id or a CIP code, or a destination's to_soc

from_soc.description: For a destination: the occupation find_transitions led from

words.description: Words the person used for work or study they have in mind

name: explore_from_my_selfie

limits.description: What this answer could not do, each { code, statement }

package.description: The person's package with the interview; absent when the call could not use it
